action_conditions.zero: physical-space zeros_like(correct), then frozen WM normalization

within_task_shuffle.rule: fixed-seed whole-chunk derangement within each task; source sample identity differs

cross_task_shuffle.rule: fixed-seed whole-chunk sample from a different task; original language is retained

action_conditions.magnitude_rule: multiply correct actions in raw physical space; do not clip; then apply frozen WM normalization

bootstrap.method: task-stratified episode-block percentile bootstrap; resample five validation demos with replacement within each task and preserve all sample rows

action_signal_checks.magnitude_primary_separation: 0.0x versus 1.0x prediction cosine separation divided by ordinary WM error
action_signal_checks.magnitude_monotonicity: Spearman correlation between abs(scale-1.0) and prediction separation from 1.0x

interpretation_rules.action_signal_pass_rule: at least three of four grouped checks pass, including correct-vs-within error advantage or ranking advantage
interpretation_rules.wm_action_ignoring_rule: action signal does not pass and task-dependent action signal does not pass
interpretation_rules.low_local_sensitivity_rule: action signal passes while frozen C1-v2.1 production candidate separation/error ratio is below 0.01

task_dependent_action_signal.alternative_delta_sign_rule: or at least two tasks have relative error increase >=0.005 and at least two have non-positive error increase

interpretation_rules.no_action_conditioning_block_rule: action signal passes, production local sensitivity ratio >=0.01, no CLIP state sensitivity limit, and no task-dependent action signal

priority_mapping.WM_ACTION_IGNORING: world-model action-aware training objective before any reranker work
priority_mapping.WM_HAS_ACTION_SIGNAL_BUT_LOW_LOCAL_SENSI: world-model local action sensitivity before reranker; candidate redesign remains diagnostic-only
priority_mapping.CLIP_STATE_SENSITIVITY_LIMIT: state representation investigation before controller design
priority_mapping.TASK_DEPENDENT_ACTION_SIGNAL: task-stratified world-model diagnosis before aggregate controller design
priority_mapping.NO_ACTION_CONDITIONING_BLOCK: reranker diagnosis may resume, but this protocol does not authorize it

optional_gradient_analysis.reason: a faithful full [8,512] by [8,7] Jacobian over representative samples is disproportionately expensive; scalar-gradient surrogates would not answer the requested Jacobian-norm question

forbidden: train or modify any world-model member
run any controller or simulator rollout
overwrite C1-v2 or C1-v2.1 negative artifacts
